# Apiary Expansion

Growing the apiary from two colonies to four before next spring.

- Order two cedar hives with queen excluders and a spare super.
- Split the strongest colony in May once drones appear.
- Ask [[Mara Lindqvist]] from the [[Northfield Beekeepers Association]] to inspect the splits.
- Plan varroa treatment for each new colony; see [[Varroa Mites]].

Last harvest gave 14 kg of honey; the extra hives should double that.
